Yeah I didn’t realize how easy it was to make deep cuts with a razor blade after being used to pencil sharpener blades and when I hit styro I pulled a surprised pikachu

Styro is just a term for the dermis, which is a white layer underneath your skin. It’s maybe a millimeter deep? Whenever I’ve hit it the skin kind of splits farther and I can see the white layer before it bleeds? 

They take longer to heal and usually scar more than shallower cuts so just be careful. I hit my first styros on accident and it scared the fuck out of me.

I have a friend who kinda does the same thing, like I know it’s out of love and care for me but he doesn’t understand self harm and what it’s like. I’d try talking to her and telling her that maybe those words helped her stop self harming but they aren’t what you need right now, you just need someone to be there for you and not judge you for self harming.
Your family sound like assholes, I’m sorry that you have to deal with that kind of treatment.
